meta.name: organic-growth-advisor
meta.description: Identify which organic growth path to pursue — new segments, geographies, channels, or products. Use when diagnosing where a growth constraint lives and which McKinsey growth level to act on next.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断增长瓶颈并选择最佳增长路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在寻找新的市场、渠道或产品增长机会。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose growth constraints and choose the best growth path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are looking for new markets, channels, or product growth opportunities.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过三个问题诊断你的增长瓶颈，然后从四个增长路径（新客户群、新地理区域、新分销渠道、新产品）中推荐一个，并给出理由和下一步实验。
howto.when: 当你说出增长停滞、不确定该选哪个增长方向，或需要快速决定先测试哪个路径时触发。

say.text: 我们B2B薪资工具在美国中端市场增长停滞了，CEO想进欧洲，销售想要SMB层级。
say.note: Claude 会开始三问诊断，定位你的增长路径。

say.text: 帮我判断应该聚焦新客户群还是新地理区域。
say.note: Claude 会通过矩阵分析给出推荐。

say.text: 我们产品市场匹配很好但增长放缓，该从哪里入手？
say.note: Claude 会诊断约束所在并建议路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will diagnose your growth bottleneck through three questions, then recommend one of four organic growth paths (new customer segments, new geographies, new distribution channels, or new products) with rationale and a first experiment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention stalled growth, uncertainty about which growth direction to pursue, or need a fast triage to choose which path to test first.

say_en.text: Our B2B payroll tool is plateaued in US mid-market. CEO wants Europe, sales wants an SMB tier.
say_en.note: Claude starts the 3-question triage to place you on the matrix.

say_en.text: Help me figure out whether to focus on new customer segments or new geographies.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and recommend a path.

say_en.text: We have strong product-market fit but growth is stalling. Where should we look?
say_en.note: Claude diagnoses the constraint and suggests a path.
